meaning:
§ Ajalon or Aijalon = "field of deer"
Levitical city in Dan, 14 miles or 25 km NW of Jerusalem, later ruled by the Amorites, then the Benjamites of Judah, then by the Philistines

elsewhere.note: Then Joshua spoke to Yahweh in the day when Yahweh delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel. He said in the sight of Israel, “Sun, stand still…
but the Amorites would dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim. Yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to forced…
They struck the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon. The people were very faint;
Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands;
Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, which are fortified cities in Judah and in Benjamin.
